summary: A monthly astrology discussion salon at The Crow & Quill in downtown Asheville, first Monday of each month 6-8pm since Feb 2026, hosted by astrologer Frank Salzano of Medicine of the Starry Heavens. Each session is a brief transit summary followed by open discussion, Q&A, and contemplative sharing among attendees rather than a lecture or class. No explicit membership roster, dues, or dedicated Facebook/Meetup group was found, but the recurring intimate discussion-circle format at a fixed small venue is the kind of setting likely to build a returning core of regulars.

evidence.note: Listing describes a fixed monthly cadence (1st Monday, 6-8pm) with discussion, Q&A and 'contemplative shares' rather than a taught class or performance.

Description invites 'all levels and curious scholars' and offers a contact email/phone to 'get involved' or 'host a Monday night,' suggesting an ongoing community rather than a one-off commercial event.

Frank Salzano runs Medicine of the Starry Heavens as an individual astrology practice based in Weaverville, NC; the salon is one of several offerings (readings, storytelling events, courses) rather than the sole focus.
No dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or membership signup for the salon itself turned up in search; only the Eventbrite/Facebook event listings and the host's business site were found.
